description: Ready-to-run ad BRIEFS by industry: dropshipping, ecommerce, mobile apps, restaurants, real estate and local services (12 trades: plumbers, electricians, hvac, roofers, landscapers, house-cleaners, pest-control, auto-repair, salons, med-spas, dentists, gyms). Compact list by default; pass `id` for one template in full: its brief (filled with the active profile's name, and the trade's specifics when `trade` is given), what the user must supply, the recommended format/aspect/length, and its web deep link. To run one, fill the [square-bracket] slots from what the user gave you, then pass the brief to plan_ad as `product` (with its format and durationSeconds) and render the plan (render_ad for video, generate_image for images). Every part is editable: a template is a shortcut, not a lane, so change or ignore anything that does not fit. These are NOT the native HTML formats of make_template_ad. Read-only, 0 credits.

id.description: one template id (from the list) to return in full, with its brief

trade.description: for local services: plumbers, electricians, hvac, roofers, landscapers, house-cleaners, pest-control, auto-repair, salons, med-spas, dentists or gyms. Fills the trade specifics into the brief

vertical.description: dropshipping | ecommerce | mobile-app | restaurants | real-estate | local-services; omit for all
